title: [BUG] Hard to trace changes in releases
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [x] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.72
- Operating System: Macos 14.5
- Terminal:  zsh

## Bug Description
Who knows what 1.0.72 has bring looking at github? Big riddle. 

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Update to newest version of anthropic
2. Run claude --verision and read version
3. Try to find out over Internet what has changed

## Expected Behavior
You see clear message of what is going on

## Actual Behavior
Dev/null - maybe Martians already hacked Claude code, but you won't find out in anyway

## Additional Context
Be descriptive in Github, in change long, in claude code it self (let --version print changes below the version print)
